summary: No fundamentals-based thesis is broken today. Every held single-stock thesis (DPZ, IDXX, CARG, FAST, MSCI, VRSN, MSM, WMT) rests on F-score, cash conversion and profitability figures that close.json and the news memory give no sign have changed, and none of the written invalidation triggers has fired. All eight are up or roughly flat on the day (DPZ +1.3%, IDXX +2.3%, CARG +3.8%, FAST +3.0%, MSCI +2.3%, VRSN +3.0%, MSM +0.3%, WMT +2.9%). Unrealized P&L is positive on every one except DPZ (-0.96%), which is well above its stop. I read no filing today; close.json carries no new 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K 2.02 or restatement for these names. The only fundamentals-relevant news in memory is DA Davidson's DPZ price-target cut to $382 (Buy kept), which is sell-side opinion, not an accounting change. ETF and crypto holdings (VOO, VTI, BND, IEF, BTC/USD) are outside the screen and I make no fundamentals call on them.
update: 1) DPZ: the $274.88 invalidation is still anchored to the $305.42 reference close, not the $316.584 fill (L1). It sits about 13% below the fill instead of the intended 10%. The position is at about $313.5 (-0.96%), so nothing is triggered, but the PM should re-anchor it to the fill, about $285. The thesis also leans on the wholesale-groceries SIC mislabel for the sector percentile (L3), so it rests on absolute quality (F-score 8/9, cfo $792M vs net income $602M) and not on the Staples rank. leverage_not_up is false, which I flagged when ranking it. Its own invalidation says a fundamentals screen that reflects the Q3 results (reported 10-13) should be checked, and the run's fundamentals input was my only source, so the Q3 check is still open. 2) IDXX: prints about 11-02, the edge of the window. Its cfo/net income cushion is thin at 1.12x, so a weak cash-flow print is the thing to watch there; the XLV-relative trigger needs the Market Analyst, not me. 3) FAST: the thesis cites cfo about 1.03x net income. The newest 10-Q is already public (10-19), so there is no earnings event ahead. The thesis stands, and cash conversion is the one number I would watch at the next 10-K. 4) VRSN, MSM, MSCI, CARG, WMT: no evidence of change. CARG reports 11-05, MSM and VRSN have already reported, and WMT's 10-23 8-K item 8.01 is still unread per the news memory (L2 open item). 5) L1 and L3 shaped these calls: I flagged the DPZ stop anchor under L1 and the DPZ/FAST/MSM/MSCI sector-label caveats under L3. I followed both lessons, and no lesson conflicted with today's evidence.
